svg.title: Screw tag anatomy — UHF transponder inside the screw head
svg.desc: Side cutaway of a machine screw with the transponder and on-metal antenna embedded in the head, showing head diameter range, thread start size and on-metal read range.
svg.text: A UHF transponder cast into the screw head — every fastener gets its own GS1 GIAI-96 serial
on-metal antenna + IC, potted in the head

g.text: Head diameter 6-16 mm carries the antenna
Impinj Monza R6-P · NXP UCODE 8 / 8m / 9 · EM4325 / EM4425 class UHF ICs
Threads from M3 x 8 slotted cheese upward
ISO 1207 / DIN 84 / ASME B18.6.3 profiles · ISO 898-1 class 4.8 to 12.9
1-3 m read range installed in metal
steel, aluminium, stainless, cast iron — read without unscrewing anything
GIAI-96 serial per screw, SGTIN-96 per SKU
EPCIS 2.0 events: assembling, disassembling, commissioning, decommissioning

svg.text: Adhesive tags identify the machine. A screw tag identifies the joint.
Swap a line-replaceable unit and the ID travels with the fastener — no relabelling step to forget.
